drainage_slope.source: IPC 704.1: horizontal drainage 2-1/2 inches or less, 1/4 inch per foot
IPC 704.1: horizontal drainage 3 to 6 inches, 1/8 inch per foot
IPC 704.1: horizontal drainage 8 inches or larger, 1/16 inch per foot

below_slab_why: company default: the invert of drainage under a slab on grade where the plans print none

fill_in.stack_basis: trade practice: floors that stack are piped alike; where a floor's rooms stand on the same rooms of the floor below (above for the lowest), its water mains run as that floor's do, fed by the same risers
fill_in.main_basis: trade practice: a main is carried on along its line to the branches it serves, at its size
fill_in.branch_basis: trade practice: each fixture's or room's branch is teed off the nearest main of its system at right angles (the typical connection of the enlarged details), the fixtures of one room and back-to-back rooms on one wet wall sharing one branch; a fixture branch nothing sizes is 1/2 inch (IPC Table 604.5 minimum fixture supply sizes are 3/8 to 1/2 inch)
